name: Deal Desk, RFP & Pipeline Hygiene Engine
description: Accelerates RFP security/compliance questionnaires with TF-IDF answer matching, validates multi-year SaaS quote discounts and gross margins against Deal Desk approval tiers, and audits CRM pipeline for slippage and multi-currency traps.

skills.summary: Matches RFP requirement rows against verified answer libraries using TF-IDF cosine similarity and flags mandatory compliance gaps.
Computes net effective discount, multi-year ramp ACV/TCV, gross margin floor compliance, non-standard terms, and required Deal Desk tier.
Audits CRM opportunities for stage staleness, push counts, missing MEDDPICC commit gates, single-threading, and multi-currency FX alignment.

connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Query Salesforce opportunities, DatedConversionRate FX tables, and quote line items via remote_cli mcp salesforce, plus RFP questionnaires and Deal Desk approvals from Google Drive or SharePoint before Python validation.

gateway_approval_actions: Updating Salesforce opportunity forecast categories, close dates, or approved quote statuses
Submitting Deal Desk discount/non-standard term exceptions for CFO or VP Sales approval
Sending completed customer RFP responses or commercial quote emails externally via Gmail/Outlook
python_code_guardrails: Mandatory DatedConversionRate FX normalization across mixed-currency CRM rollups
Zero-guess abstention when approved RFP answer library contains no verified match
Indirect prompt-injection directive quarantine inside external customer RFP rows

scheduled_routine.name: weekly-pipeline-hygiene-audit
scheduled_routine.title: Weekly Pipeline Hygiene Audit
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the weekly Salesforce pipeline hygiene and slippage audit using scripts/pipeline_slippage_auditor.py. Normalize multi-currency opportunities, identify stale stages, >=2 push-count deals, single-threaded Commit opportunities, and StageName/IsClosed inconsistencies without modifying CRM records autonomously.
